reasons.plausibility: Embedding physical constraints into a transfer-learned model for mechanical property prediction is technically sound, though the assumed error margins (10–15%) for fracture toughness introduce some minor uncertainty.
reasons.testability: Its blinded forward-prediction and subsequent direct comparison with experimental tensile and fracture test data provides a clear, decisive path for falsification.
reasons.usefulness: A physics-informed surrogate model that significantly reduces computational costs yet maintains suitable accuracy would be very attractive and impactful for rapid stochastic design of high-entropy alloys.
